extension_name.description: The extension's name, shown on the Chrome Web Store listing, in chrome://extensions and under the toolbar icon. Keep it short: the store truncates around 45 characters. 'LaunchPad' is the product name and is NOT translated.

extension_description.message: Unlimited organized shortcuts on your new tab page. Groups, drag-and-drop, dark mode. Free and private.
extension_description.description: The Chrome Web Store short description, limit 132 characters. 'Free and private' is a factual claim about the product (no account, no tracking, all data local) and must stay accurate in every language, not become a marketing flourish.
